tool_schemas.name: qdrant-store
tool_schemas.description: Upserts one or more memory points into the specified collection in the given workspace, creating new point IDs when omitted and treating external_point_id as a stable client key for idempotent upserts/deduplication; returns the stored/updated point identifiers (and any per-point status the service provides). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/collection_id/id formats don’t match the required patterns, if any point is missing required fields (content_text, embedding), or if an embedding vector length does not match the collection’s configured vector_size. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot write to the workspace/collection, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or collection does not exist, CONFLICT if the request attempts an invalid upsert for an existing point (for example, duplicate identifiers that cannot be reconciled within the same request), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits for the workspace are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the collection and points.

collection_id.description: Vector collection id to upsert memories into.

points.description: List of memory points to upsert into the collection.

id.description: Internal memory point id; if omitted a new id is generated.

external_point_id.description: Client-provided stable id for idempotent upserts/deduplication.

content_text.description: Raw text content of the memory.

embedding.description: Vector embedding for the memory (length should match collection.vector_size).

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON payload metadata stored alongside the vector.

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-find
tool_schemas.description: Runs a similarity search over memories within a workspace (and collection when specified), using either query_embedding or query_text (which the server may embed), and returns up to top_k/limit matches ordered by similarity; each match includes only the fields requested via include_payload/include_embedding/include_content and pagination is supported via the returned opaque cursor for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id (or collection_id when provided) fails validation, if neither query_text nor query_embedding is provided, if top_k/limit are < 1, or if query_embedding length does not match the collection’s vector_size. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read the workspace/collection, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or collection does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when search/read limits for the workspace are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Vector collection id to search (defaults to workspace.default_collection_id if omitted by the server).

query_text.description: Free-text query to find similar memories (server may embed this to a vector).

top_k.description: Number of most similar memories to return.

filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied against stored payload fields.

include_payload.description: Whether to include the stored payload object in each match.

include_embedding.description: Whether to include the stored embedding vector in each match.

include_content.description: Whether to include the stored content_text in each match.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for paginating through results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (used for pagination; may mirror top_k).

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-list-collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists vector collections in a workspace, optionally filtering by status and paginating results; returns collection summaries and refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the API key is invalid/revoked or lacks required scope.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list collections for.

name_prefix.description: Optional prefix match filter for collection names.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-get-collection
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single vector collection by id; returns the collection configuration (vector_size, distance, payload_schema) and refuses with NOT_FOUND if it does not exist in the workspace or is not visible to the caller.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the collection.

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-create-collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new vector collection in the workspace with the given vector size and distance metric; returns the created collection record and refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid configuration or CONFLICT if the name is not unique per workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the collection in.

name.description: Human-readable collection name (must be unique per workspace).

vector_size.description: Dimension of vectors stored in this collection.

distance.description: Distance function used for similarity search.

default_top_k.description: Default number of results to return when top_k is not specified.

payload_schema.description: Optional schema or hints for payload fields to support filtering/indexing.

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-update-collection
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable properties of a vector collection (for example default_top_k, payload_schema, or status transitions); returns the updated collection and refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions or when attempting to modify a deleted collection.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the collection.

name.description: New collection name (must remain unique per workspace).

payload_schema.description: New payload schema/hints (replaces existing when provided).

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the collection (active↔rebuilding, active/rebuilding→deleted).

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-get-memory-point
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single memory point by id from a collection; returns the point data and refuses with NOT_FOUND if the point does not exist or is tombstoned (unless include_deleted is true).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the collection and point.

collection_id.description: Vector collection id that contains the point.

point_id.description: Internal memory point id to fetch.

include_payload.description: Whether to include the stored payload object.

include_embedding.description: Whether to include the stored embedding vector.

include_content.description: Whether to include the stored content_text.

include_deleted.description: Whether to allow returning tombstoned points (when true, deleted_at may be returned).

tool_schemas.name: qdrant-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the presented API key, including workspace, key status, scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the API key is missing, invalid, or revoked.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace context for reporting effective permissions and defaults; when omitted, returns the API key’s home workspace.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def qdrant_whoami(workspace_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0013000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0013000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if workspace_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^qdr_ws_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", workspace_id):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspace_id.")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    reqs = _load("search_requests.json")

    def _new_req_id():
        import secrets
        return f"qdr_req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"

    # This endpoint requires an API key, but the tool signature carries none.
    # Resolve the presented identity from the store by selecting an active key that can serve requests.
    # If none exist anywhere, return UNAUTHORIZED.
    key = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if key is None:
        # still log request
        req_row = {
            "id": _new_req_id(),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id or "qdr_ws_unknown",
            "api_key_id": None,
            "tool_name": "qdrant-find",
            "status": "received",
            "collection_id": None,
            "input": {"endpoint": "qdrant-whoami", "workspace_id": workspace_id},
            "result_count": None,
            "latency_ms": None,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        reqs.append(req_row)
        _save("search_requests.json", reqs)
        req_row["status"] = "failed"
        req_row["error_code"] = "UNAUTHORIZED"
        req_row["error_message"] = "API key missing or invalid."
        req_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        req_row["latency_ms"] = max(0, int(round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)))
        _save("search_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key missing, invalid, or revoked.")

    home_ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == key.get("workspace_id")), None)
    ctx_ws = None
    if workspace_id is None:
        ctx_ws = home_ws
    else:
        ctx_ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)

    # Log received
    req_row = {
        "id": _new_req_id(),
        "workspace_id": (ctx_ws.get("id") if ctx_ws else (workspace_id or key.get("workspace_id"))),
        "api_key_id": key.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "qdrant-find",
        "status": "received",
        "collection_id": None,
        "input": {"endpoint": "qdrant-whoami", "workspace_id": workspace_id},
        "result_count": None,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }
    reqs.append(req_row)
    _save("search_requests.json", reqs)

    def _finish(status, error_code=None, error_message=None):
        req_row["status"] = status
        req_row["error_code"] = error_code
        req_row["error_message"] = error_message
        req_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        req_row["latency_ms"] = max(0, int(round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)))
        _save("search_requests.json", reqs)

    # Validate requested workspace context if provided
    if workspace_id is not None and ctx_ws is None:
        _finish("failed", error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="Workspace not found.")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.")

    # Authorization: key must be active (already ensured), but also must belong to context workspace for "effective" context.
    # If caller asks for a different workspace than key's home, refuse.
    if workspace_id is not None and key.get("workspace_id") != workspace_id:
        _finish("failed", error_code="UNAUTHORIZED", error_message="API key does not belong to the specified workspace.")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key does not belong to the specified workspace.")

    # Compute rolling 60s usage for this key, and effective rpm limit (key override only; no workspace default in schema)
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    window_start = now_dt - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
    def _parse_ts(s):
        if not s or not isinstance(s, str): return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"): s = s[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    used_last_60s = 0
    for r in reqs:
        if r.get("api_key_id") != key.get("id"):
            continue
        ts = _parse_ts(r.get("created_at"))
        if ts is None:
            continue
        if ts >= window_start and ts <= now_dt:
            used_last_60s += 1

    limit_rpm = key.get("rate_limit_rpm")
    remaining = None
    reset_in_s = None
    if isinstance(limit_rpm, int) and limit_rpm >= 1:
        remaining = max(0, limit_rpm - used_last_60s)
        reset_in_s = 60

    # Update last_used_at on successful whoami
    for k in api_keys:
        if k.get("id") == key.get("id"):
            k["last_used_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
            k["updated_at"] = k.get("updated_at") or k["last_used_at"]
            break
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    identity = {
        "api_key": {
            "id": key.get("id"),
            "name": key.get("name"),
            "status": key.get("status"),
            "scopes": key.get("scopes"),
            "rate_limit_rpm": limit_rpm,
            "last_used_at": next((k.get("last_used_at") for k in api_keys if k.get("id") == key.get("id")), key.get("last_used_at")),
            "created_at": key.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": next((k.get("updated_at") for k in api_keys if k.get("id") == key.get("id")), key.get("updated_at")),
        },
        "workspace": (ctx_ws if ctx_ws is not None else home_ws),
        "rate_limit": {
            "window_seconds": 60,
            "used_in_window": used_last_60s,
            "limit_rpm": limit_rpm,
            "remaining_in_window": remaining,
            "reset_in_seconds": reset_in_s
        }
    }

    _finish("succeeded")
    return {"identity": identity}

metadata.name: Qdrant Server
metadata.description: This backend stores vector "memories" and supports inserting them into a Qdrant-like store and searching/retrieving them later. The main workflows are: (1) write/upsert memories into a collection, (2) run similarity searches to find relevant memories, and (3) track API usage and operational status f
